verdict.rationale: GitLab's homepage says its agents "review code while your team stays in control," and the Duo Agent Platform lets users delegate routine tasks to agents. Third-party partners (CodeAnt AI, Greptile) also bring AI code reviews to GitLab merge requests. However, the first-party evidence is marketing-level only, and nothing shows a user actually assigning an AI as a merge request reviewer. Missing for 10: documented mechanism to assign an AI reviewer to a merge request, in-depth first-party docs on AI code review behavior and turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration.
